title: Gambonanza texture pack registry entry
description: One file per texture pack in registry/texturepacks/<id>.json. A texture pack is art and wording, never code: the zip holds PNGs and a manifest, and the framework applies it at runtime without touching the game's own files. The zip lives on the author's own GitHub release; the registry only records where it is and what it hashed to when a human reviewed it.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Must match the file name.

summary.description: One line, shown on the pack's card.

repo.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository whose releases hold the zip. Downloads are pinned to this repo.

asset.description: Release asset file name, optionally with * wildcards, e.g. "midnight-chess-*.zip".

tagPattern.description: Which release tags count, e.g. "pack-v*". Defaults to every tag.

preview.description: A screenshot of the pack in the game. raw.githubusercontent.com only - it is the one image host the manager's renderer allows.

pending.description: Accepted before the first release exists; the index refresh picks it up when the zip appears.
